C1464.title: Simulated Cyberattack Paralyzes Thermal Power Generation Simulation Platform
C1464.summary: In April 2024, cybersecurity engineers demonstrated a cyberattack against a thermal power generation simulation platform in a lab. The attack successfully paralyzed the entire simulated thermal power plant.
